observations: EAX is saved and restored as a 32-bit register; the saved-stack lookup consequently uses BP+8.
The free-entry search is inlined and the non-free allocation byte is restored with MOV.
limitations: ORG is used only for this isolated target-layout experiment.
The fatal path is a placeholder excluded from the compared range.
Formal sysinit1 source and the complete IO.SYS have not been reconstructed or verified by this test.
